motivation: ma_ribbon_r1 found edge only in slow trend rules; pattern_lab_r1 base 2-day triple-barrier labels showed AUC ~0.5. Test whether a model can filter trend-rule trades (meta-labeling) using pattern/indicator features.
data_and_windows: identical to configs/pattern_lab_r1_protocol.json (development decisions 2019-09-08..2025-09-13, selection validation 2024-01-01..2025-09-13, opened-year check 2025-09-24..2026-09-22 once)

primaries.P_long: 4h EMA20/EMA200 ribbon long: long while close > EMA20 > EMA200 (dev-selected in ma_ribbon_r1)
primaries.P_long_short: same plus short while close < EMA20 < EMA200

candidate_trade: each primary entry (target changes to +1/-1 at decision t) until the primary target changes (decision e, exit at open e+1)
meta_label: 1 if the primary trade's net return under normal costs is > 0
features: pattern_pipeline.build_matrix at the entry decision bar (4h plus daily context); feature sets: base, all (base+candles+chart+indicators); columns kept if >50% non-missing and non-constant in development
model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.03, max_iter=300, min_samples_leaf=30, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=0), one model over both sides with a side feature
walk_forward: expanding; refit every 90 days from 2021-01-01; a trade is trainable only if its exit fill bar is at least 12 bars before the refit bar
policy: take the primary trade iff p > threshold; skipped trades stay flat until the next primary entry
threshold_selection: maximize validation net (normal) subject to >= 20 validation trades; ties -> higher threshold
costs: ma_ribbon_r1 normal / stress / actual funding; fixed quantity at entry; also report daily-rebalanced sensitivity is NOT required here

acceptance.development: walk-forward net > 0 under stress, Sharpe above the unfiltered primary over the same window, >= 60 trades
acceptance.opened_year_check: net > 0 normal and stress, intrabar DD <= 20%, and above the unfiltered primary
acceptance.then: freeze; prospective shadow; no live orders
